summary.intent: Close out CipherBox phase 69 (FUSE/WinFsp rust integration + node/v3 migration) and determine what remains before the phase can be marked complete, per user pushback that desktop-e2e must be exercised with real root-key recovery rather than a placeholder.
summary.outcome: Confirmed 19/20 plans merged and workspace green, but the user blocked completion pending real desktop root-key recovery; a delegated research agent mapped the full root-key lifecycle gap between web (v3, shipped) and desktop (legacy v2 + bridge hack), producing a ~5-plan wiring breakdown and a design doc, with the research findings committed and a planner about to author the plans.

repo: Web vault registration generates two independent random 32-byte keys (rootReadKey/rootWriteKey), not derived from anything — desktop cannot substitute HKDF derivation for them.
Desktop is still on the legacy v2 single-key vault blob model and fabricates node/v3 read/write keys via a `^0xA5` XOR bridge instead of real per-key crypto.
A web-created v3 vault is literally unreadable by the desktop today (`fetch_and_decrypt_vault` errors 'not v2 format'), and vice versa — the two clients are on incompatible blob formats.
The root Ed25519 IPNS keypair is HKDF-derived (deterministic) and is NOT stored in the vault blob; only the two ECIES-wrapped root keys are.
The API DB is zero-knowledge for vaults — `vaults` table stores only `owner_public_key` + `root_ipns_name`, no key material.

A frozen cross-language KAT (`tests/vectors/vault-v3-blob.json`) already exists from #578, waiting on the Rust v3 blob codec port — the crypto and test vectors are ready, only the Rust implementation is missing.

Desktop-e2e stack requirement: full local (non-docker) provisioning of Postgres 16, apps/api, Kubo v0.34, Redis, mock-ipns-routing, plus platform FUSE driver, using `--dev-key` + `/auth/test-login` headless recipe (keypair comes from the server, not the CLI key).

code.finding: Web generates rootReadKey/rootWriteKey as two independent random 32-byte keys at vault registration (not derived).
Vault blob v3 format: `0x03 | u16(readLen) | ECIES(read) | u16(writeLen) | ECIES(write)`.
Rust implements only the legacy v2 vault blob format; v3 (two-key) codec is unported.
KeyState only has `root_folder_key`; needs `root_read_key`/`root_write_key` fields for v3.
Location of the `^0xA5` bridge that fabricates node/v3 keys from the single legacy root key; must be deleted once real recovery lands.

workflow: When a research question spans multiple subsystems (web TS registration model + desktop Rust recovery + KeyState + e2e harness requirements), delegate the mapping to an agent to keep the orchestrating context clean before designing.

User treated 'desktop-e2e passes against a placeholder key bridge' as proving nothing — insisted on wiring real recovery as the actual completion bar rather than accepting a technically-green but meaningless test.

friction: Initial phase completion report was pushed back on by the user — desktop-e2e's placeholder bridge key would have made a 'passing' test meaningless, requiring a scope reopening after the assistant had already declared the non-Windows work done.

Stale comments in desktop code cite 'phase 63 stubbed' as the reason for the bridge, which is outdated — the web actually shipped the real v3 model in #578/69-20, so the comment misled initial assessment of remaining work.
open_items: Author and execute the ~5-plan wiring breakdown: (1) Rust v3 blob codec + cross-language KAT, (2) KeyState two-key fields, (3) desktop vault init/recovery to v3 + delete derive_root_node_keys, (4) mount wiring in auth.rs/fuse/mod.rs deleting the ^0xA5 bridge, (5) fix desktop-e2e verifier (verify-filepointer.mts still reads retired rootFolderKey).
Run desktop-e2e green as the real completion gate after wiring lands.
69-14/WinFsp remains unimplemented — marked autonomous:false, requires the user's Windows box; deleted publish_file_metadata has Windows callers that 69-14 must rewire.
ROT-07: shared-scope-exit deletes still fail-closed (EIO) until a production RotationDeps impl is wired.
